operations.description: Validate empty/full membership, accessibility, and union closure exactly.
operations.name: am_validate

operations.description: List the declared finite feasible family in deterministic mask order.
operations.name: am_feasible_sets

operations.description: Emit all removable-element witnesses for every nonempty feasible set.
operations.name: am_accessibility_witnesses

operations.description: Check every ordered feasible-pair union and report an exact certificate.
operations.name: am_union_closure_certificate

operations.description: List admissible one-element continuations from a declared feasible state.
operations.name: am_extensions

operations.description: Compute the exact antimatroid rank of a declared subset.
operations.name: am_rank

operations.description: Compute the unique maximal feasible subset of a declared subset.
operations.name: am_basis

operations.description: Enumerate all finite basic words whose prefixes remain feasible.
operations.name: am_basic_words

operations.description: Restrict the feasible family to a declared trace and revalidate it.
operations.name: am_trace

operations.description: Compute exact complementary convex-geometry closure for a declared subset.
operations.name: cg_closure

operations.description: List complements of feasible sets as the exact closed-set family.
operations.name: cg_closed_sets

operations.description: Compute extreme points using finite closure deletion tests.
operations.name: cg_extreme_points

operations.description: Check the anti-exchange implication over every closed set and element pair.
operations.name: cg_anti_exchange

operations.description: Compute one exact closed-set meet and closure-of-union join certificate.
operations.name: cg_lattice_meet_join

operations.description: Check antimatroid validity and cardinality under a declared permutation.
operations.name: am_relabel_covariance

operations.description: Delete one declared element and validate the induced feasible family.
operations.name: am_deletion

operations.description: Compare rank and basis before and after one declared deletion.
operations.name: am_sensitivity

operations.description: Render a structural explanation while reserving human accessibility review.
operations.name: am_accessible_explanation

operations.description: Keep real learner, curriculum, calibration, and effectiveness evidence open.
operations.name: am_real_learning_gap

operations.description: Reserve consequential learning, allocation, and governance decisions to competent and affected authorities.
operations.name: am_authority_gate
